'''Salita Toranes''' is an [[Aes Sedai]] and for a while a rebel [[Sitter]] of the [[Yellow Ajah]]. 

== Appearance ==
Salita is a dark-skinned [[Tairen]],{{ref/book|8|19}} with skin "as dark as charcoal".{{ref/book|10|17}} She is plump, with a round face{{ref/book|10|17}} and cool eyes. She is about 5'4 tall.

She is known for her love of clothes, allegedly emptying her trunk every morning to find the perfect outfit, such as a yellow-slashed green dress embroidered with yellow scroll work on the bosom.{{ref/book|11|23}}

==Strength and Abilities==
Salita is of [[Strength in the One Power among Aes Sedai|low average]] strength for an Aes Sedai, with a [[One Power]] level of {{opsl|33}}. She would be unable to [[Traveling|Travel]] without linking with another channeler.

She appears to be a very fast learner with an eidetic memory. She doesn’t need to see a weave formed more than a couple of times to be able to reproduce it perfectly. She quickly mastered the new [[Healing]] weaves introduced by [[Nynaeve]].

==History==
She is from a lesser noble house of [[Tear]] and still receives money from her estate. 

She was born in {{ne|933}} and went to the Tower in {{ne|950}}. 

She remained Novice nine years and seven as Accepted and she was raised to the shawl in {{ne|966}}. Due to her quick learning Talent she might well have been allowed to move through Novice and Accepted even faster had she had also a stronger potential in the Power.

Salita is one of the Yellows who believes the other Ajahs are merely adjuncts to their own, as they believe [[Healing]] is the only useful application of the [[One Power]].

== Activities ==
Following the White Tower split in {{ne|999}}, Salita has allied herself with the [[Salidar Aes Sedai]]. 

Later that year, she was elected a [[Sitter]] for the Yellow Ajah. [[Romanda Cassin]], her fellow Yellow Sitter and [[First Weaver]], considered her intelligent, but a bad and inexperienced choice for a Sitter, and would much rather have had [[Dagdara Finchey]] raised. Unbeknownst to Romanda, Dagdara was Black Ajah.

She was jointly responsible for electing [[Egwene al'Vere]] as [[Amyrlin]].{{ref/book|6|35}}

Salita sometimes supported Egwene in the Hall and sometimes not.

At the War Vote, Salita stands voting positively.{{ref/book|8|19}} Later, when the report on events at [[Shadar Logoth]] is delivered to the Sitters, she and [[Romanda]] arrive early to hear it. Salita again votes positively on an alliance with the Black Tower.{{ref/book|10|19}}

She is one of the two Aes Sedai spectators who watch [[Kairen Stang]] and [[Ashmanaille]] turn ordinary iron into [[Cuendillar]].{{ref/book|10|17}} She complains because she thought that Aes Sedai should not be making things for sale. Being a noblewoman with income from her estate she is casual about money and contemptuous of trade.

At [[Lelaine Akashi]]'s emergency meeting of the Hall, she stands to accept the offer from the [[Dragon Reborn]] of bonding forty-seven [[Asha'man]].{{ref/book|11|23}}

After the reunification of the Aes Sedai factions, she resigned her place as Sitter.
